2609.02548.title: Learn from Whoever Is Right: Answer-Verified Multi-Teacher Distillation for Multi-Domain LLMs
2609.02548.paper_summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) rely on reinforcement learning to build strong capabilities in individual domains, but integrating those capabilities into a single deployable model remains challenging. By routing each sample to the teacher whose domain matches it, existing approaches let a domain label decide which teacher provides supervision. However, domain expertise holds only on average: the matched teacher is not always correct on a given sample, while a teacher from another domain sometimes is. The reliable teacher therefore has to be identified per sample, not per domain. In this paper, we introduce Multi-Teacher Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (MT-SDPO), an on-policy distillation method that unifies several frozen teachers into one student model. MT-SDPO consists of three components: (1) self-anchors, where a rollout is supervised by a correct rollout from its own group; (2) answer-verified eligibility, where a teacher may supervise a sample only if its own answer passes a verifier; and (3) privileged distillation, which merges the anchor and all verified feedback into one context that an exponential moving average self-teacher reads and the student does not, thereby keeping one policy at deployment. Across five students from three model families, MT-SDPO lifts the weakest domain of Qwen3-8B by 14.79 points and narrows its domain gap by 74.7%, a better balance than serving one matched teacher per domain. Verified reliability, not domain membership, should decide who teaches. Code is available at https://github.com/hexixiang/MT-SDPO.
2609.02548.paper_summary_zh: 現代大型語言模型（LLMs）依賴強化學習在各個領域建立強大的能力，但將這些能力整合到一個可部署的模型中仍然具有挑戰性。通過將每個樣本路由到與其領域匹配的教師，現有的方法讓領域標籤決定哪位教師提供監督。然而，領域專業知識僅在平均情況下成立：匹配的教師在給定樣本上不總是正確，而來自另一領域的教師有時卻是正確的。因此，可靠的教師必須根據每個樣本來識別，而不是根據每個領域。在本文中，我們介紹了多教師自蒸餾政策優化（MT-SDPO），這是一種統一多個凍結教師為一個學生模型的在線蒸餾方法。MT-SDPO由三個組件組成：（1）自我錨定，其中一個回合由其自身組的正確回合監督；（2）答案驗證的資格，其中教師僅在其自身答案通過驗證者時才可監督樣本；以及（3）特權蒸餾，將錨定和所有經過驗證的反饋合併為一個上下文，供指數移動平均自教師閱讀，而學生則不閱讀，從而在部署時保持一個政策。在來自三個模型系列的五個學生中，MT-SDPO將Qwen3-8B的最弱領域提升了14.79分，並縮小了其領域差距74.7%，這比每個領域服務一位匹配教師的平衡更好。經過驗證的可靠性，而非領域成員資格，應該決定誰來教學。代碼可在 https://github.com/hexixiang/MT-SDPO 獲得。
